nodes.description: Public immutable-by-assignment address of the Chainlink aggregator (0xDC3EA94CD0AC27d9A86C180091e7f78C683d3699) used as the price source.
External view function getPrice() that returns the Chainlink latestAnswer() divided by 100 to convert SNX-USDC (6 decimals) into a target price.
Untrusted external call IChainlink(chainlink).latestAnswer(); the returned price is consumed directly, so a malicious/incorrect aggregator address would return an attacker-controlled value.
Arithmetic conversion of the oracle answer by integer division (/ 100), which silently truncates precision and operates on unvalidated external data.

edges.reason: getPrice() reads the chainlink state variable to determine the oracle contract address.
Execution of getPrice() directly invokes the external latestAnswer() call on the oracle contract.
The chainlink state variable is used as the target address of the untrusted external call.
The untrusted return value of latestAnswer() flows into the integer division by 100, causing truncation of unvalidated external data.
getPrice() performs the /100 arithmetic conversion before returning the price.
